pages.title: About
pages.text: A cold desert planet. Tier 2 rocket. Gravity is about 27% of Earth's. There is nothing to breathe: the real Martian air is almost all carbon dioxide. You need a $(l:space/survival/oxygen)mask, tanks$() and $(l:space/survival/hazards#heat)Thermal Padding$().

pages.title: Landing
pages.text: You come down here on Landing Balloons, not a lander. Take your rocket and cargo out of them after touchdown.

pages.title: Dust storms
pages.text: Mars has dust storms: thick fog rolls in, and you only hear the noise with a Frequency Module, which goes in the last gear slot. You can wait a storm out in a $(l:space/survival/oxygen#sealer)sealed base$().

pages.title: Resources and life
pages.text: Desh, iron, copper and tin. Slimelings live here and can be tamed. Underground sludge is dangerous, as Sludgelings live in it. You can also build a $(l:space/tech/space_station)space station$() around Mars.

pages.title: The dungeon
pages.text: The boss here is a giant creeper. It fires explosives, and fire breaks out around it. The treasure room holds the tier 3 rocket schematic.

pages.title: Phobos
pages.text: A moon of Mars. Tier 2 rocket. Gravity is only 17% of Earth's, so jump carefully. It is barely cold. Phobos has iron, nickel, desh and meteoric iron, which makes it handy for a first meteoric supply. Phobos regolith goes into the heavy plate of the $(l:space/tech/high_rockets)tier 4 rocket$().

pages.title: Deimos
pages.text: The second moon. In this game it only stays on the map, and you cannot land on it.

pages.title: Desh
pages.text: The main metal of Mars for parts and armor.
